about: Counting from Kun 0 to Qian 63: structure short 4, a loop of about 15 s (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-structure-shorts-design.md). The Leibniz lesson's ring count (Diagram.tsx 'count'), 0 to 63 in one pass. Queued overnight 2026-10-01. Draft 2: Astra's revision adopted as is, round 1 (docs/research/2026-10-01-codex-structure-count.md).
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the two lessons, so the terminal pieces end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 100 bpm, G# major, from 91 s as on 5, 39 and 60; no other structure short uses it

endcardNote: a loop: no end card, so the last frame runs back into the first
caption: Read the I Ching’s six-line patterns as binary numbers: broken = 0, solid = 1, with the bottom line as the leftmost digit. On the circle attributed to Shao Yong, count up the right half from 0 to 31, then up the left from 32 to 63; sixlines.day.

pages.a:
THE I CHING IS A BOOK.
64 PATTERNS, SIX LINES EACH.
READ BROKEN AS 0, SOLID AS 1.
THAT GIVES 0 TO 63.
